episodes.synopsis: Gingka saves Kenta and is challenged to an uneven battle.
episodes.title: Pegasus has Landed

episodes.synopsis: Madoka fights Kyoya with a broken bey Pegasus; Kyoya receives a strange visitor, who makes an enticing offer.
episodes.title: Leone's Roar!

episodes.synopsis: Kenta challenges Gingka; Kyoya loses a battle and must leave with his opponent to train.
episodes.title: The Wolf's Ambition!

episodes.synopsis: Doji has a gift for Benkei, who later battles Gingka.
episodes.title: Charge! Bull Power

episodes.synopsis: Gingka is forced to battle a crab-obsessed villain who has kidnapped Madoka.
episodes.title: Vengeful Gasher

episodes.synopsis: Kenta poses as Gingka for a fight with Hikaru.
episodes.title: Aquario's Challenge

episodes.synopsis: Benkei mentors Kenta, who wants a rematch with Hikaru; Madoka helps Kenta develop a special move.
episodes.title: It's Our Special Move! Saggitario

episodes.synopsis: Kyoya must prove himself during a challenge set up by Doji; Gingka thinks he's on a game show, but he's really being monitored by a computer.
episodes.title: Merci's Dangerous Trap

episodes.synopsis: Kyoya battles Benkei; Gingka challenges Hikaru.
episodes.title: Leone's Counterattack

episodes.synopsis: Gingka battles Kyoya, who creates a tornado that rips through the city.
episodes.title: Heated Battle! Gingka Versus Kyoya

episodes.synopsis: Gingka hunts for Doji at the Dark Nebula headquarters.
episodes.title: Chase the Wolf

episodes.synopsis: Merci sets traps for the gang inside the castle; Doji invites Gingka to join forces with him.
episodes.title: Infiltrate the Dark Nebula's Castle

episodes.synopsis: Gingka battles an old nemesis who uses Gingka's anger to fuel a forbidden bey.
episodes.title: L-Drago Awakens!

episodes.synopsis: Gingka's motivation for defeating Ryuga is revealed through a flashback focusing on his father.
episodes.title: Memories of Ryo

episodes.synopsis: The gang go after Gingka, who has decided to go home. The journey is perilous, and the group encounter a strange traveler along the way.
episodes.title: Mysterious Hyoma

episodes.synopsis: Hyoma leads the gang to Gingka, but Kyoya is suspicious of Hyoma's intentions.
episodes.title: The Magnificent Aries

episodes.synopsis: Gingka searches for a scroll that could mean more power for Pegasus.
episodes.title: The Silver Pegasus

episodes.synopsis: Gingka battles Hyoma---whom he's never been able to defeat---and uses his new power.
episodes.title: The Green Hades

episodes.synopsis: Benkei and Kenta team up for a tournament after learning to swap parts of their beys, which increases their power.
episodes.title: Conquer the Tag-Team Battle

episodes.synopsis: Gingka and friends enter the Survival Battle contest, in which the winner receives one wish. Meanwhile, Ryuga goes to a remote area and meets a powerful opponent.
episodes.title: Begin! The Survival Battle!

episodes.synopsis: Only eight competitors remain in The Survival Battle.
episodes.title: Warriors on A Deserted Island

episodes.synopsis: In the jaw-dropping finale of The Survival Battle, everyone is surprised by who emerges victorious.
episodes.title: The Fearsome Libra

episodes.synopsis: As the winner of the Endurance Battle, Yu is granted his wish: to have the biggest Beyblade competition in the world.
episodes.title: The Road to the Battle Bladers

episodes.synopsis: Battles heat up as the Bladers earn points for entry into the Battle Bladers competition. Gingka meets a new rival, Tsubasa, who tests his strength.
episodes.title: The Beautiful Eagle

episodes.synopsis: Kyoya comes across a calculating opponent Tobio, aka Captain Capri, with an erratic playing style that puts Kyoya's skills to the test.
episodes.title: The Sniper Capricorn

episodes.synopsis: Tsubasa's skills catch the eye of Doji's Dark Nebula Organization.
episodes.title: Tsubasa Flies Into The Dark

episodes.synopsis: The competition to make it into Battle Bladers heats up with Yu battling Hyoma and Tsubasa battling Kenta.
episodes.title: Intruders In The Challenge Match

episodes.synopsis: As everyone gears up for Battle Bladers, the crab-obsessed Tetsuya is up to his usual tricks.
episodes.title: Dark Gasher's Big, Crabby-Crabby Organization

episodes.synopsis: Kenta befriends a new blader, Sora, who has amazing power but lacks control.
episodes.title: Kenta and Sora

episodes.synopsis: Gingka is pushed to the limits when he enters an important challenge match and faces a self-proclaimed sorcerer named Ryutaro.
episodes.title: The Bewitching Pisces

episodes.synopsis: Four battles are underway in four different stadiums as the competition to make it into Battle Bladers heats up.
episodes.title: The Twin Gemios

episodes.synopsis: In an exciting challenge match for Battle Bladers, six bladers are pitted against each other at the same time.
episodes.title: The Stormy Battle Royale

episodes.synopsis: When Phoenix saves Gingka's Bey Pointer from Tetsuya's claws, Gingka puts everything on the line in a battle with Phoenix.
episodes.title: The Oath of the Phoenix

episodes.synopsis: Gingka has to create a new special move when battling a new opponent Teru, who is a former dancer.
episodes.title: Shine, Virgo!

episodes.synopsis: When Tsubasa is caught sneaking into the Dark Nebula, he must battle his way through Dark Nebula Bladers to earn his freedom.
episodes.title: L-Drago, on the Move

episodes.synopsis: Tsubasa is almost defeated by Ryuga in an intense battle until Phoenix comes to the rescue. Gingka fights Tobio in a stadium of moving walls.
episodes.title: Broken Wings

episodes.synopsis: When a gang led by Busujima takes over their stadium, Kenta and Sora have to battle hard to reclaim what is theirs.
episodes.title: Rock Scorpio's Deadly Poison

episodes.synopsis: Gingka must decide between a last opportunity to earn points and defending his friends against Tsubasa.
episodes.title: Run, Gingka!

episodes.synopsis: Phoenix appears and challenges Tsubasa and Gingka to a battle. Tsubasa's true loyalties are revealed.
episodes.title: Clash! The Fireblaze vs The Pegasus

episodes.synopsis: With Doji in charge of the tournament, Battle Bladers begins and the gang pitted against tough opponents.
episodes.title: GO! Battle Bladers!

episodes.synopsis: In the opening matches, Hyoma goes up against a new Dark Nebula Blader, Reiji. Ryuga battles Hikaru.
episodes.title: The Serpent's Terror

episodes.synopsis: The gang vows to avenge Hikaru's loss in the next round of battles. Yu battles Reiji to prove his worth to Dark Nebula.
episodes.title: The Dragon's Punishment

episodes.synopsis: In the second round of Battle Bladers, Doji is up to his usual tricks. Benkei faces Kyoya and Gingka takes on Ryutaro.
episodes.title: The Deck is Stacked

episodes.synopsis: Kenta, determined to win for Yu and all true Bladers, takes on Reiji in the next round of the tournament.
episodes.title: Entrusted Emotions

episodes.synopsis: Tsubasa fights his most difficult battle, against Ryuga and his Bey Lightning L-Drago.
episodes.title: Eagle Counterattacks

episodes.synopsis: Gingka takes on Reiji in the semi-finals. Hyoma and Kenta go after Yu when he is kidnapped by Doji.
episodes.title: Libra Disappears

episodes.synopsis: Phoenix arrives in the nick of time to help Kenta and Hyoma. Gingka's battle with Reiji at Battle Bladers heats up.
episodes.title: Bonds of Steel

episodes.synopsis: The Phoenix's shocking true identity is revealed. Ryuga betrays Doji.
episodes.title: The Truth about Light and Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Kyoya must face Ryuga in the semi-finals at Battle Bladers. The winner will go on to face Gingka in the final match.
episodes.title: Fierce Battle! Lion VS Dragon

episodes.synopsis: The epic final match of Battle Bladers begins with more than just victory on the line.
episodes.title: The Furious Final Battle!

episodes.synopsis: The Battle Bladers final match continues, and Gingka must summon all of his strength if he is to win and save the future of Beyblade.
episodes.title: Blader's Spirit
